blocks.text: الدرس 270. الكلمات الجديدة: mask، tend، deny، promises، grade، ordinary، coast، mystery، princess، proof.

blocks.note: مثال: Ziri removed the mask. — نزع زيري القناع.
مثال: Yanni didn't deny that. — لم ينفي ياني ذلك.
صيغة من promise (المضارع مع الغائب المفرد)؛ مثال: Yanni kept his promises. — كان ياني يفي بوعوده.
مثال: Sami was an ordinary Muslim. — كان سامي مسلما عاديّا.
مثال: Space is full of mystery. — الفضاء مليئ بالغموض.
مثال: He saved the princess. — أنقذ الأميرة.
مثال: We wanted proof. — كنا نريد أدلة.

blocks.text: No one can deny the fact.
blocks.note: لا يستطيع أحد أن ينكر هذا.

blocks.text: Ziri has a good dust mask.
blocks.note: يملك زيري قناعا جيدا للوقاية من الغبار.

sentences.t: We wanted proof.
Ziri removed the mask.
He saved the princess.
Yanni didn't deny that.
Where was the princess?
Yanni kept his promises.
No one can deny the fact.
sentences.ar: لا يستطيع أحد أن ينكر هذا.

sentences.t: Space is full of mystery.
Ziri didn't demand proof.
Ziri has a good dust mask.
sentences.ar: يملك زيري قناعا جيدا للوقاية من الغبار.

sentences.t: Are you really a princess?
David didn't even deny that.
Ziri will keep his promises.
Sami was an ordinary Muslim.
The murder remains a mystery.
Sami's life was very ordinary.
Sami led a very ordinary life.
sentences.ar: كان سامي يعيش حياة عاديّة للغاية.

sentences.t: Sami went back to ordinary life.
You must keep the promises you make.
Tom's death still remains a mystery.
sentences.ar: ما زال الغموض يلفّ مقتل سامي.

sentences.t: Flavio saw nothing out of the ordinary.
sentences.ar: لم يرى فلافيو أي شيء خارج عن العادة.

sentences.t: They're likely to forget their promises.
What happened to them is still a mystery.
sentences.ar: ما حدث لهم لا يزال لغزا.

sentences.t: The mystery of her death was never solved.
Sami was struck down by a mystery illness.
Sami knew that Muslims were ordinary people.
sentences.ar: كان سامي يعلم أنّ المسلمين أناس عاديّون.

sentences.t: What happened on that boat remained a mystery.
sentences.ar: ما حصل على متن تلك السّفينة بقي لغزا.

sentences.t: Nothing out of the ordinary happened on our trip.
sentences.ar: لا شيء خارق للعادة حدث أثناء سفرنا.

sentences.t: A book is proof that humans are capable of working magic.
sentences.ar: أَلكِتَابُ بُرْهَانٌ أَنَّ اْلإنْسَانَ قَادِرُونَ عَلَى اْلسِّحْرِ.

sentences.t: Tom can't deny the fact that he did what Mary accused him of doing.
sentences.ar: لا يستطيع توم أن ينفي ما تتّهمه ماري بفعله.
